lines.text: Every week, a Grade 11 student juggles six subjects, homework from every teacher, tests, and sport.
lines.phonemes: ˈɛvɹi wˈiːk, ɐ ɡɹˈeɪd ɪlˈɛvən stˈuːdənt dʒˈʌɡəlz sˈɪks sˈʌbdʒɛkts, hˈoʊmwɜːk fɹʌm ˈɛvɹi tˈiːtʃɚ, tˈɛsts, ænd spˈɔːɹt.

lines.text: At a school of four and a half thousand students, there's one counsellor for every nine hundred or so.
lines.phonemes: æɾə skˈuːl ʌv fˈɔːɹ ænd ɐ hˈæf θˈaʊzənd stˈuːdənts, ðɛɹz wˈʌn kˈaʊnsəlɚ fɔːɹ ˈɛvɹi nˈaɪn hˈʌndɹɪd ɔːɹ sˈoʊ.

lines.text: So the students who fall behind are spotted far too late.
lines.phonemes: sˌoʊ ðə stˈuːdənts hˌuː fˈɔːl bᵻhˌaɪnd ɑːɹ spˈɑːɾᵻd fˈɑːɹ tˈuː lˈeɪt.

lines.text: That's where Murshid comes in.
lines.phonemes: ðæts wˈɛɹ mˈʊɹʃɪd kˈʌmz ˈɪn.

lines.text: Meet Ahamed.
lines.phonemes: mˈiːt ˈɑːhəmɛd.

lines.text: He has a mid-term coming up, with football and swimming on top.
lines.phonemes: hiː hɐz ɐ mˈɪdtˈɜːm kˈʌmɪŋ ˈʌp, wɪð fˈʊtbɔːl ænd swˈɪmɪŋ ˌɔn tˈɑːp.

lines.text: He asks Murshid to plan his week.
lines.phonemes: hiː ˈæsks mˈʊɹʃɪd tə plˈæn hɪz wˈiːk.

lines.text: It reads his timetable, his tests and his training, and writes the plan straight into his calendar.
lines.phonemes: ɪt ɹˈiːdz hɪz tˈaɪmteɪbəl, hɪz tˈɛsts ænd hɪz tɹˈeɪnɪŋ, ænd ɹˈaɪts ðə plˈæn stɹˈeɪt ˌɪntʊ hɪz kˈæləndɚ.

lines.text: Now his English teacher, Ms. Thomas, posts one assignment.
lines.phonemes: nˈaʊ hɪz ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ tˈiːtʃɚ, mˈɪz tˈɑːməs, pˈoʊsts wˈʌn ɐsˈaɪnmənt.

lines.text: It lands in every student's plan, and Murshid replans each week around it.
lines.phonemes: ɪt lˈændz ɪn ˈɛvɹi stˈuːdənts plˈæn, ænd mˈʊɹʃɪd ɹᵻplˈænz ˈiːtʃ wˈiːk ɚɹˈaʊnd ɪt.

lines.text: A work session on their lightest day, a reminder the evening before, and a flag for anyone at risk, with the reason why.
lines.phonemes: ɐ wˈɜːk sˈɛʃən ˌɔn ðɛɹ lˈaɪɾɪst dˈeɪ, ɐ ɹᵻmˈaɪndɚ ðɪ ˈiːvnɪŋ bᵻfˈɔːɹ, ænd ɐ flˈæɡ fɔːɹ ˈɛnɪwˌʌn æt ɹˈɪsk, wɪððə ɹˈiːzən wˈaɪ.

lines.text: And it never asks you to just trust it.
lines.phonemes: ænd ɪt nˈɛvɚɹ ˈæsks juː tə dʒˈʌst tɹˈʌst ɪt.

lines.text: Murshid is an agent. It understands the goal, plans the steps, uses tools on the student's own timetable, and takes action.
lines.phonemes: mˈʊɹʃɪd ɪz ɐn ˈeɪdʒənt. ɪɾ ˌʌndɚstˈændz ðə ɡˈoʊl, plˈænz ðə stˈɛps, jˈuːsᵻz tˈuːlz ɔnðə stˈuːdənts ˈoʊn tˈaɪmteɪbəl, ænd tˈeɪks ˈækʃən.

lines.text: Then it shows its working. Every step.
lines.phonemes: ðˈɛn ɪt ʃˈoʊz ɪts wˈɜːkɪŋ. ˈɛvɹi stˈɛp.

lines.text: It even finds the best day to set homework.
lines.phonemes: ɪɾ ˈiːvən fˈaɪndz ðə bˈɛst dˈeɪ tə sˈɛt hˈoʊmwɜːk.

lines.text: Set it Tuesday, due Thursday, and it's eighty-three percent likely to come in on time.
lines.phonemes: sˈɛt ɪt tˈuːzdeɪ, dˈuː θˈɜːzdeɪ, ænd ɪts ˈeɪɾiθɹˈiː pɚsˈɛnt lˈaɪkli tə kˈʌm ɪn ˌɔn tˈaɪm.

lines.text: The three students at risk get extra support.
lines.phonemes: ðə θɹˈiː stˈuːdənts æt ɹˈɪsk ɡɛt ˈɛkstɹə səpˈɔːɹt.

lines.text: Every Friday, each student's weekly report sends itself, and rolls up here.
lines.phonemes: ˈɛvɹi fɹˈaɪdeɪ, ˈiːtʃ stˈuːdənts wˈiːkli ɹᵻpˈɔːɹt sˈɛndz ɪtsˈɛlf, ænd ɹˈoʊlz ˌʌp hˈɪɹ.

lines.text: So teachers can see who needs help, before it is too late.
lines.phonemes: sˌoʊ tˈiːtʃɚz kæn sˈiː hˌuː nˈiːdz hˈɛlp, bᵻfˌɔːɹ ɪɾ ɪz tˈuː lˈeɪt.

lines.text: Privacy is built in, not bolted on.
lines.phonemes: pɹˈaɪvəsi ɪz bˈɪlt ˈɪn, nˌɑːt bˈoʊltᵻd ˈɔn.

lines.text: Consent is recorded for every purpose.
lines.phonemes: kənsˈɛnt ɪz ɹᵻkˈɔːɹdᵻd fɔːɹ ˈɛvɹi pˈɜːpəs.

lines.text: School data never mixes with family accounts.
lines.phonemes: skˈuːl dˈeɪɾə nˈɛvɚ mˈɪksᵻz wɪð fˈæmɪli ɐkˈaʊnts.

lines.text: Nothing is sent without a person saying yes, and every change is logged.
lines.phonemes: nˈʌθɪŋ ɪz sˈɛnt wɪðˌaʊt ɐ pˈɜːsən sˈeɪɪŋ jˈɛs, ænd ˈɛvɹi tʃˈeɪndʒ ɪz lˈɔɡd.

lines.text: Murshid.
lines.phonemes: mˈʊɹʃɪd.

lines.text: Every student on top of their work.
lines.phonemes: ˈɛvɹi stˈuːdənt ˌɔn tˈɑːp ʌv ðɛɹ wˈɜːk.

lines.text: Every teacher with the full picture.
lines.phonemes: ˈɛvɹi tˈiːtʃɚ wɪððə fˈʊl pˈɪktʃɚ.

lines.text: Try it today, at murshid-web dot vercel dot app, slash judges.
lines.phonemes: tɹˈaɪ ɪt tədˈeɪ, æt mˈʊɹʃɪd wˈɛb dˈɑːt vˈɜːsəl dˈɑːt ˈæp, slˈæʃ dʒˈʌdʒᵻz.
